review_candidates.description: Role Overview We are seeking a reliable, operations-minded analyst to join our 24/7 Connected Vehicle Operations team. This is not a traditional customer-facing help desk role; rather, you will be responsible for ensuring that critical safety and connectivity services (such as SOS and Destination Assist) function correctly for customers when they are needed. The ideal candidate is a methodical troubleshooter who can balance traditional NOC monitoring with hands-on manual testing of vehicle systems and mobile applications. You will follow strict procedures, maintain clear documentation, and execute seamless shift handoffs. Key Responsibilities Monitor AWS CloudWatch dashboards and alerts. Validate system health, escalate issues via email and ticketing systems, and coordinate communications with external vendors and OEM partners. Manual Testing (Approx. 50% of role): Perform hourly remote testing on mobile phone applications (approx. 8 minutes per cycle). Conduct hourly bench testing in the office (approx. 10–15 minutes per cycle) by pushing buttons on devices to validate Destination Assist and SOS location receipt. Conduct manual testing on physical vehicles every 4 hours (or as needed if automation fails) to ensure signal integrity. Connect/disconnect trickle chargers, jumpstart vehicles as needed, and drive vehicles short distances to acquire a better signal for testing (all other testing is indoors). Respond to emails, communicate with third parties (OEMs, vendors, emergency response centers), and maintain detailed logs of all testing and incidents. Maintain solid handoffs between shifts, follow standard operating procedures with critical thinking, and support a 24/7 coverage model. Required Qualifications Experience: Background in NOC (Network Operations Center), production operations, IT support, or systems/network monitoring. Technical Skills: Ability to read and interpret AWS CloudWatch graphs and metrics. Driving: Valid driver's license and ability to drive vehicles for signal testing purposes. Soft Skills: Reliable, operations-minded, methodical troubleshooter with strong written and verbal communication skills. Schedule: Ability to work a 24/7 rotating shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. (Training is provided on M–F business hours for the first few weeks).

Contribute to data standards, naming conventions, modelling patterns and semantic layer governance. Collaboration with PMIT Development & Data Teams Work closely with PMIT developers, data engineers, integration specialists and solution architects. review_candidates.title: Técnico de Manutenção de Via Permanente (Ferroviário) - Linhas 8 e 9
review_candidates.description: Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva? A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Missão do Cargo Garantir a segurança, a disponibilidade e a conformidade técnica da via permanente, por meio da inspeção sistemática e da manutenção preventiva e corretiva de trilhos, dormentes, fixações, lastro, Aparelhos de Mudança de Via (AMVs) e demais componentes da superestrutura e infraestrutura ferroviária, assegurando a circulação segura das composições nas Linhas 8 e 9. Responsabilidades Realizar inspeções periódicas (a pé, veicular ou por carro de inspeção) ao longo da via, identificando desvios de bitola, nivelamento, alinhamento, empeno e demais parâmetros geométricos. Inspecionar trilhos quanto a desgaste, trincas, fissuras, corrugação, soldas e juntas, registrando ocorrências conforme normas técnicas e procedimentos internos. Inspecionar dormentes (madeira, concreto ou aço), identificando trincas, quebras, apodrecimento e perda de fixação. Inspecionar Aparelhos de Mudança de Via (AMVs), agulhas, cruzamentos e componentes móveis, verificando folgas, desgaste, lubrificação e funcionamento dos mecanismos de acionamento. Verificar o estado do lastro ferroviário (brita), drenagem, taludes e faixa de domínio, apontando riscos de instabilidade. Utilizar instrumentos de medição (régua de bitola, nível, paquímetro, trena, carrinho de inspeção) para aferição de parâmetros geométricos da via. Elaborar relatórios técnicos de inspeção, registrando não conformidades, criticidade e priorização de intervenções. Executar serviços de manutenção em trilhos, dormentes, fixações (grampos, placas de apoio, tirefões, parafusos) e AMVs. Realizar apertos, substituições e ajustes de componentes da via, conforme cronograma de manutenção preventiva. Apoiar e/ou executar atividades de socaria, nivelamento e alinhamento manual ou mecanizado da via. Realizar reparos emergenciais em caso de falhas ou ocorrências que comprometam a circulação segura dos trens. Zelar pela correta sinalização e isolamento da área de trabalho durante intervenções na via (bloqueio de via, sinalização de segurança). Registrar atividades em sistemas de gestão de manutenção (ex.: ordens de serviço, planilhas de inspeção, softwares de gestão ferroviária). Alimentar indicadores de manutenção (disponibilidade, criticidade de ativos, backlog de intervenções). Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à via permanente. Requisitos e qualificações Curso Técnico completo em Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Via Permanente, Transporte Ferroviário, ou áreas correlatadas. Conhecimento e experiência com normas técnicas de via permanente (parâmetros de bitola, nivelamento, alinhamento, empeno). Experiência em Processos de inspeção visual e instrumentada de via. Experiência com funcionamento e manutenção de Aparelhos de Mudança de Via (AMVs). Experiência com procedimentos de segurança ferroviária (acesso à via, bloqueio, sinalização). Experiência com Leitura de desenhos técnicos e especificações de manutenção. Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de manutenção (CMMS/SAP PM ou similar). Informações adicionais Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em 13 estados do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira. Confira os benefícios que oferecemos: 🩺 Assistência Médica-Hospitalar; 🦷 Assistência Odontológica; 🤝 Seguro de Vida; 🍝 Vale Refeição ou Alimentação; 🚇 Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento no local; ☂️Previdência Privada; 🫄Licença Estendida: maternidade 180 dias e paternidade 20 dias; 👶 Auxílio Creche; 💪 Wellhub (Gympass); 🎂 Day off aniversário (Folga); 📈 PLR (Participação nos lucros ou resultados); ⏰ Política de flexibilidade na jornada de trabalho, e muito mais! Quer melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade e contribuir para chegarmos ainda mais longe? Então, traga o seu talento para a Motiva.

review_candidates.title: Supply Data Analyst
review_candidates.description: Location: Any MSF office* Contract: 100% Duration: 12 months Starting date: 04th of January 2027 Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026 Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate. The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables. The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst. Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables. Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba). III. ACCOUNTABILITIES The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them. 1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives 2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods 3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise 4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…) c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences 5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines) b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery 6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed. Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. REQUIREMENTS Education Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential) Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential) Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential) Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential) Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable) Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable) Skills Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes Strong analytical skills Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment Drive for change, improvement and innovation Languages Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Good command of French (strongly desirable) Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures.
